request: Replace the ornate and cramped lower selection bar with a cleaner treatment
title: Simplify showcase selection bar
purpose: Make selected pie details feel as restrained as the storefront header

files.purpose: Make selected pie details feel as restrained as the storefront header
files.previous_behavior: The lower bar showed a boxed category marker, Korean serif text, a layered red button, and decorative shadows, creating a crowded appearance.
files.new_behavior: The lower bar presents the pie name and flavor note at left, with price, detail link, and a plain text purchase action at right. A single thin divider separates the bar from the cabinet; mobile spacing is tuned for the smaller viewport.
files.data_impact: None; CSS changes presentation only and do not read or write operational data.
files.access_control_impact: None; no authentication, role, or permission behavior changed.
risks: The unboxed purchase action could be less prominent for some users; the 390px and 1920px layouts were visually checked.
files.rollback: Revert this commit to restore the prior ornate selection bar styles. There are no data compatibility steps because only presentation rules changed.

production_safety.operational_data: No production operational data was read, created, updated, or deleted.
production_safety.schema_migration: None; no schema or stored data changed.
external_side_effects: None; local preview and screenshot checks only.

verification.command: Playwright Chromium screenshots at 1920x910 and 390x844 against local development port 3101
verification.evidence: Visually inspected the reduced ornamentation, text hierarchy, and mobile spacing.

residual_risks: The plain purchase action may need further visual refinement after user review.
